thread:
maria-ramirez: Quick ask — ACME POC pulled way more tokens than expected in early tests (approx 1.2B total during dry run). Can we offer a temporary soft per-token cap + one-off grace bucket for the first 30 days so they don't hit hard throttles or get unexpected bills?

sam-deals: What exactly are you proposing? waive min? temporary tiering? rough $ amount?

maria-ramirez: Proposal below — short and concrete so deal desk can triage quickly. TL;DR: waive monthly min for the first billing period, give a 500k-token pilot credit (applied as a grace bucket), enforce a soft cap per API key/day to avoid runaway spikes, allow burst above soft cap up to credit. Overage billed at normal hosted rates.

praveen-ops: We can implement the quota/soft-cap config on the infra side (rate limiting + alerts). Billing pipeline changes are separate. Which billing account/POC id?

maria-ramirez: Account: ACME-42 (PO in progress). Financial ask: ~$1.1k in pilot credit (500k tokens at standard hosted rate) + waive min charge for month 1. Technical: soft cap 200k tokens/day per API key; burst allowed to 500k/day using pilot credit; alerts to #sales and #eng-oncall when usage > 80% of soft cap.

sam-deals: Can you paste the minimal rule we should present to deal desk/finance? I'll file the request.

maria-ramirez: Sure — copyable snippet for deal desk email/code block:

```
Pilot billing proposal for ACME-42:
- pilot_credit_tokens: 500000
- waive_monthly_min: true (first 30 days)
- soft_cap_per_key_per_day: 200000
- burst_allowed_up_to: 500000 (consumes pilot_credit_tokens)
- overage_rate: hosted.standard_per_token
- alerting: email #sales + ping @praveen-ops at 80% of soft_cap
```

sam-deals: Great. @leah-finance can finance approve a one-off pilot credit and min-waive for one month? This is under $2k on list estimate.

leah-finance: We can approve a one-time pilot credit of 500k tokens and waive the monthly minimum for the initial 30-day pilot. Need to record as a credit memo and have a short MOU that clarifies credits are non-refundable and apply only to usage. Also need ACME's PO number sent to billing before applying credits.

jonathan-legal: We can draft a one-paragraph MOU for pilot credits. Suggested clause: "Pilot credits are a one-time concession, non-refundable, applicable only to usage during the pilot period; no ongoing pricing changes implied." Send me the exact account / dates and I'll draft.

sam-deals: I'll collect PO info and attach to the deal desk ticket. Filing request now: amount estimate $1,100 credit + waive month 1 min. Tagging @leah-finance for approval.

leah-finance: No objections from finance. Please create ledger entry so support/billing knows to apply credits at invoice time.

billing-bot: Created credit memo #CM-2026-045 for 500k-token credit applied to acct ACME-42, effective 2026-04-01.

maria-ramirez: Nice — ops, can you set the soft cap + alerting as discussed? I'll add a note to the POC docs with the config. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

praveen-ops: Will do. ETA for config + alerting: 4 business hours. I'll post the config snippet here once deployed.

maria-ramirez: Perfect — will follow up after PO lands.
